criteria.text: Anorexia associated with weight loss in AIDS or nausea/vomiting associated with cancer chemotherapy.
Documented trial and failure or intolerance of megestrol acetate suspension.
Documented trial and failure or intolerance of at least one prior antiemetic, including a serotonin 5HT3 antagonist, antihistamine, corticosteroid, prokinetic, or phenothiazine.

notes: Partial encoding from Alaska Medicaid Marinol Criteria Version 1. PDF Last updated 3/15/2013; Approved 3/15/2013. Extracted effective_date is null; source effective_date retains the archived stub placeholder 1970-01-01, not a policy effective date.
Marinol (dronabinol): 2.5 mg, 5 mg and 10 mg capsules; Schedule III (CIII) controlled substance.

Encoded: AIDS anorexia/weight loss requires documented megestrol acetate suspension failure or intolerance; cancer chemotherapy nausea/vomiting requires documented failure or intolerance of at least one prior antiemetic. Requirements are gated by indication.

Documentation (manual review): submit documentation/chart notes for AIDS; for chemotherapy submit dates of each therapy, notes for discontinuation/treatment failure, and the current chemotherapy schedule.
Authorization (manual review): coverage may be approved for up to 6 months for either indication.
Dispensing limits (manual review): AIDS anorexia/weight loss — 30-day supply with a quantity limit of 2 doses per day; cancer chemotherapy nausea/vomiting — 30-day supply per chemotherapy cycle.
